purpose: Complete the fixed E01-E20 V171 low-load training cohort without rerunning E02, E04 or E20, then apply the unchanged full-cohort throughput, QPR and mechanism gates exactly once.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

checks: exact remaining17 seed product and fixed order with no diagnostic seed or baseline rerun
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing for all seventeen new runs
the run_config and every window retain the frozen V171 concurrency, deterministic quota, CPU, short-work and queue boundaries
each active window has heavy count strictly above two and each inactive window has count at or below two
every active window admits at most the first two heavy terminal players in ascending request_id then function_id order and rejects only the excess
inactive windows retain exact V170/V159 terminal admission and parents-completed heavy players bypass the guard
both placement-router branches and all short-work queue/work invariants are audited across the combined twenty-run cohort
the sealed diagnostic blind audit remains byte-identical and contributes E02, E04 and E20 mechanism evidence
the superseded V155 cohort assembly is excluded and the sealed V170 predecessor is used only for the preregistered diagnostic authorization
zero throughput, completion, latency, cost or QPR fields are parsed before the blind audit is sealed

full_cohort_selection_rule.evaluation: Combine the seventeen new V171 rows with the sealed V171 E02, E04 and E20 rows, yielding exactly one retained row for each E01-E20 seed.
full_cohort_selection_rule.throughput_mean_gate: strictly greater than frozen Orion 1.4741 requests/ms
full_cohort_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 positive paired differences against Orion
full_cohort_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both finite-only and zero-completed-as-zero QPR means strictly greater than frozen OCS 0.055577160345697
full_cohort_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 positive paired differences against OCS with all 20 finite-only values
full_cohort_selection_rule.joint_pass: all unchanged metric gates and the result-blind mechanism audit pass
full_cohort_selection_rule.success: freeze the complete V171 E01-E20 NSESche low-load cohort as the closed homogeneous 20-node low result and authorize a separately committed downstream reuse/export plan
full_cohort_selection_rule.failure: retain all twenty valid V171 runs without deletion or selective rerun, keep homogeneous low open, and require a new result-informed causal plan before any further NSESche experiment
full_cohort_selection_rule.paper_claim_on_training_success: none until a separately frozen confirmation or final-data boundary is committed
